description: Replaceable printed insulating PCB adapter for a square 20 mm M3 mounting interface.
releaseRequirements: Qualify the selected insulating material, print orientation, contact lands and delivered PCB revision.
Check both M3 mounting spans, the 2 mm foot web, ordinary nut fit and selected screw engagement on the actual base.
Preserve clear access to components, solder pads, antenna, cables and fastener tools; a shared raster does not establish a safe installed layout.
Assign fit tolerances and handling loads and inspect the finished adapter before assembly.
